description: Merge any set of recipes (each at its own servings) into one shopping list. The same ingredient is combined across recipes and converted to what a store sells ("10 cloves garlic → buy 1 head"), grouped by aisle. extra_items keep the amount the cook gave ("2 lb bananas" stays 2 lb). One that matches a recipe ingredient is added to that line when the units agree, or shown beside it when they don't ("Lemons: 1 + 2 lb"). Staples like salt and oil, anything listed in pantry, and the cook's saved pantry staples go to a separate check-the-pantry group. Items that hit the cook's allergies are flagged. Signed in, the list is saved to the cook's kitchen and returns a shareable list url and id for order_groceries. Works signed out too: the list comes back without being saved (no url or id), with a next step to keep it (keep: true asks the cook to sign in).

extra_items.description: Anything else for the same trip, as the cook said it, amount included: ["paper towels", "2 lb bananas"]. A matching recipe ingredient gets that quantity added when the units agree, or both amounts when they don't.

include_staples.description: Put salt, oil, sugar, etc. on the list instead of the pantry check

keep.description: Save the list to the cook's kitchen. Signed in it is always saved; signed out, keep: true asks the cook to sign in first

pantry.description: Ingredients the cook already has, e.g. ["flour", "eggs"]

units.description: US cups/oz/°F or metric grams/ml/°C. Defaults to the cook's setting.

name: build_shopping_list
title: Build a merged shopping list
